title: Balochistan Prosecution Service Constitution Function and Powers Amendment Act 2010

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Prosecution Service Constitution Function and Powers Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 2010
ACT III OF 2010
BALOCHISTAN PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION,
FUNCTION AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act to amend the Balochistan Prosecution
Service
(Constitution, Function and Powers) Act, 2003 (Balochistan
Act No. VI of 2003) for the purposes hereinafter appearing
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
7th April, 2010]
No.PAB/Legis:V(3)2010, dated 7-4-2010.---The Balochistan
Prosecution Service (Constitution) Function and Powers) (Amendment) Bill, 2010
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan
on 30th March, 2010 and assented to by the Governor Balochistan
on 7th April, 2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly;--
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
1. Short title
and commencement.---(l) This Act may be called the Balochistan
Prosecution Service (Constitution, Function and Powers) (Amendment) Act, 2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary,

No.PAB/Legis:V(3)2010,
dated 7-4-2010.---The Balochistan Prosecution Service (Constitution) Function
and Powers) (Amendment) Bill, 2010 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Balochistan on 30th March, 2010 and assented to by the Governor
Balochistan on 7th April, 2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly;--
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
2. Amendment of
section 6(1) Act VI of 2003.---In
the Balochistan Prosecution Service (Constitution, Function and Powers) Act,
2003, hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in subsection (1) of section 6
for the words "through a competitive examination held by the Balochistan
Public Service Commission" the words "through a written
examination and interview held by the Balochistan Public Service
Commission" shall be substituted.
